objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.state
objective.description: DSL capacity used in N4 to invoke reflexive.read.state on a sibling context

#root.role: Invoke reflexive read.state on the remote beta child context and return its state payload.

effects.inter_context_route: A DSL invoke crosses contexts and awaits a remote reflexive response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes a remote reflexive state snapshot returned from a sibling context.
invariants: sandbox.dsl.remote.state must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.dsl.remote.state returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.dsl.remote.state fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
